title: Restore missing UK VAT country configuration and calculations

requirements.text: Add United Kingdom (GB) to the country configuration used by the VAT calculator UI so that UK is treated as a fully supported, configured country (not shown as missing/unconfigured) wherever country configuration is displayed.

quotes: UK country confiigeration is missing. Add back the UK Tax Rate and calculations as per the earlier versions

acceptanceCriteria: Any UI that uses country configuration lookup (e.g., the country VAT details screen) successfully resolves 'GB' and does not show 'Country configuration not found' for the United Kingdom.
The United Kingdom configuration displays standard rate 20% and reduced rate 5% (and, where applicable, includes zero rate 0% as UK-specific).
UK is marked as configured/available in the same way as existing EU countries (i.e., the primary CTA to proceed is not disabled due to missing config).

requirements.text: Restore the UK VAT rate handling and calculations so that selecting sellerCountry 'GB' applies UK rules (standard 20%, reduced 5%, zero-rated where eligible) consistently in the unified VAT calculation flow and in result outputs.

quotes: Add back the UK Tax Rate and calculations as per the earlier versions

acceptanceCriteria: When sellerCountry is 'GB' and the transaction is domestic UK, the calculator applies 20% VAT by default for standard/other categories and computes vatAmountCents and grossAmountCents correctly.
When sellerCountry is 'GB' and the selected/product category is UK reduced-eligible, the calculator applies 5% and computes amounts correctly.
When sellerCountry is 'GB' and the selected/product category is UK zero-eligible, the calculator applies 0% and computes amounts correctly.

For UK-specific scenarios already supported in the unified flow (reverse charge, export, exempt, UK zero/reduced), the returned result includes a consistent scenario/message/label and correct vatRatePercent and cent amounts.

requirements.text: Ensure UK/GB aliasing is handled consistently across the VAT calculator so that links or inputs using 'UK' behave identically to 'GB' (including country selection, URL query parameter, and config lookup).

quotes: UK country confiigeration is missing. Add back the UK Tax Rate and calculations as per the earlier versions

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to the calculator with ?country=UK initializes the flow as United Kingdom and calculations run without a 'country not supported' error.
All VAT configuration lookups and country-dependent UI logic treat 'UK' as 'GB' consistently (no mixed state where some parts treat 'UK' differently than 'GB').

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep all VAT logic on the frontend (no new backend canisters/services; backend remains single-actor).
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding non-UK/non-EU countries or implementing USA/APAC tax calculation support.
Changing Stripe/payment country allowlists unless they are directly required for UK VAT calculation/config display.
